source_policy.input: Only archived plaintext report content is passed to the extractor.
source_policy.ground_truth_note: Scenario expectations were reviewed from the plaintext reports for this product contract. AnnoCTR labels and linking annotations are not extraction answers.

cases.title: (Cyber) GRU (XIV): conclusions
cases.review_basis: The full text is a strategic conclusion and attribution discussion without a source-local attack progression.

cases.title: The First Step: Initial Access Leads to Ransomware
cases.review_basis: The report separately describes multiple tracked actors, but generic ecosystem capability statements must remain unassigned and must not be promoted merely to satisfy multi-activity cardinality.

cases.title: Squirrelwaffle: New Loader Delivering Cobalt Strike
cases.review_basis: Word and Excel delivery variants retain separate entry behavior and converge on the Squirrelwaffle payload; files, loaders, URLs and Cobalt Strike are Context.

cases.title: CloudFall Targets Researchers and Scientists
cases.review_basis: The report explicitly describes two attack-chain variants and conditional execution checks.

cases.title: Targeted Attack on Government Organizations Delivers Netwire RAT
cases.review_basis: The report declines conclusive attribution while mentioning multiple groups as historical users; document variants with the same behavior remain Context differences rather than fabricated Action branches.

cases.title: Mustang Panda Recent Activity: Dll-Sideloading trojans with temporal C2 servers
cases.review_basis: Only relations supported by exact source wording are accepted; adjacent technical details are not automatically connected.

cases.title: APT28 Delivers Zebrocy Malware Campaign using NATO Theme as Lure
cases.review_basis: ATT&CK IDs may be present or absent without changing Action identity, relation evidence or publishability.

cases.title: Whatta TA: TA505 Ramps Up Activity, Delivers New FlawedGrace Variant
cases.review_basis: The loader sequence provides a long baseline and explicitly marks KiXtart as an optional step.
